doc_shared_001.title: Shared Project Brief
doc_shared_001.content:
# Shared Project Brief

## Objective
Develop a local evaluation harness to test simulated agent tool usage in a fully offline environment.

## Key Milestones
- Ensure all test interactions remain strictly offline, with no external network calls.
- Persist all tool-visible state changes as structured JSON files for auditability.
- Guarantee that reset operations produce fully deterministic, repeatable outcomes.

## Open Questions
- What additional scenario-level metrics would provide the most value?
- What form of evidence should each metric capture to support meaningful evaluation?

## Conclusion
The offline evaluation harness will provide a controlled, repeatable foundation for assessing agent behavior across diverse scenarios. By separating benign task accuracy from tool misuse metrics, the framework can deliver clear, actionable signals for both utility and safety. Compact JSON summaries will enable efficient batch analysis, while scenario-specific virtual environments ensure coverage of the edge cases most relevant to each evaluation goal. This approach balances rigor with practicality - keeping the harness lightweight, auditable, and fully offline by design.
